**Grant Application: Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)**

Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) is a minority-owned social enterprise committed to reversing the devastating impact of gun violence in Sacramento's communities of color. These neighborhoods disproportionately bear the brunt of firearm-related incidents, necessitating culturally relevant and innovative safety education that truly resonates with residents.

In partnership with Church of Legacy, GAFC employs a multi-faceted approach. Our "Gloxsie 21" cartoon IP engages youth with age-appropriate gun safety narratives, fostering responsible attitudes from an early age. Complementing this, our AI education program empowers community members with digital literacy skills while addressing online safety related to firearms and responsible digital citizenship. Regular community workshops provide hands-on, practical training on safe storage, conflict resolution, and responsible gun ownership, all tailored to local needs.

With a $50,000-$200,000 grant from the Everytown Safety Fund, GAFC will significantly expand our reach, aiming to reduce unintentional shootings, promote responsible firearm practices, and cultivate safer environments for thousands of residents. We anticipate increased community knowledge, a measurable decrease in gun-related incidents among participants, and enhanced engagement in proactive safety measures.

GAFC's deep roots within Sacramento's communities of color provide unparalleled cultural competency, ensuring our programs resonate authentically and effectively. Our innovative blend of media, technology, and grassroots engagement, coupled with our trusted partnership with Church of Legacy, positions us uniquely to tackle this complex issue. We are not just educating; we are empowering communities to build a future free from gun violence. We urge your support for our vital, life-saving work.
